name: awrouter
description: OpenRouter for your own fleet: pick a model backend by cost/latency/ capability, fail over, fit the context window, stream. Standalone, OpenAI-compatible, no Aither-specifics required to be valuable.
adopt: Point it at your backends (vLLM / llama.cpp / any OpenAI-compatible endpoint); ask it which backend should serve model X right now, or to stream a completion with failover and context fitting.
